mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Dazzling Angel: "Flying. Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life."
# The trigger is M20 Impassioned Orator's verified record, word for word; Flying is compiled.
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.GAIN_LIFE, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever another creature you control enters, you gain 1 life.
